pestphp/pest-plugin-browser.description: Fix expectScreenshot() unconditionally failing when the tolerant threshold comparison actually passes (missing return after Page.php's foreach loop)

Add Chromium launch flags for deterministic screenshot rendering on Linux (font hinting/LCD text/color profile) -- the plugin's own maintainers don't trust screenshot assertions on Linux/CI without this class of mitigation, see PR pestphp/pest-plugin-browser#175
Fix Execution::resetAssertions() passing Assert::class instead of null as ReflectionProperty::setValue()'s first argument for a static property (PHP 8.1 deprecation)

pestphp/pest-plugin-mutate.description: Bound the composed --filter argument length in MutationTest::start() -- a mutation covered by hundreds/thousands of tests can build a --filter regex past Linux's 128 KiB MAX_ARG_STRLEN, crashing proc_open() with ProcessStartFailedException ("Argument list too long") and killing the entire test:mutate run; falls back to running the full testsuite for that one mutant instead, which is always correctness-preserving

Fix MutationTestRunner::run() building $coveredLines directly from lineCoverage()'s raw per-line array, which since phpunit/php-code-coverage 14 is keyed by an interned test index (int) with the hit count as the value, not a list of test id strings -- MutationTest::start() then fed a hit-count int straight into preg_match(), fatalling with 'Argument #2 ($subject) must be of type string, int given' on the very first covered mutation. Resolves each surviving index back to its real test id via testIds() before handing $coveredLines off

smarty/smarty.description: Fix TemplateBase::$compile_id's @var docblock (string) contradicting its own `= null` default and setCompileId()'s real usage -- confirmed by reading the class itself; no native property type declared, so PHPStan trusts the wrong docblock

Fix Smarty::unregisterFilter()'s @param docblock typo `callback|string` (not a real PHP/PHPStan type -- resolves to the unrelated class Smarty\callback) to the real accepted type `callable|string`, matching its own _getFilterName() implementation
